basic_details.job_title: ICAR CIFE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Research Associate, Junior Research Fellowship Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICAR – Central Institute of Fisheries Education (ICAR CIFE) Recruitment Notification 2026 has been released on 15 October 2026 on the official website, cife.edu.in. A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for Research Associate (RA) and Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) posts under the ICAR CIFE Recruitment 2026.

vacancy_details.Monthly Emolument: Rs. 37000/- (1st & 2nd year) fixed; Rs. 42000/- (3rd year) fixed

post_wise_breakdown.monthly_emolument: Rs. 37000/- (1st & 2nd year) fixed; Rs. 42000/- (3rd year) fixed

how_to_apply: Prepare your application along with required educational certificates and documents.
Submit your application by email to [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the designated email address on or before 11 November 2026.
important_instructions: Above position is purely temporary. The tenure and service conditions for RA and JRF will be governed by ICAR guidelines. Only candidates who fulfill all eligibility conditions will be invited to appear for the walk-in-interview. Place of work will be at ICAR-CIFE, Mumbai. TA/DA will not be provided. Wherever age-related relaxations are claimed on account of category & previous employment, certificates are to be sent along with documents under GOI norms. The RA/JRF shall have no legal right to claim regularization or absorption against any regular posts.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary and on a contractual basis for three years. The incumbent shall not have any claim for regular appointment under ICAR. For the Research Associate post, the monthly emolument is Rs. 61000/- plus 30% HRA. For the Junior Research Fellowship post, the emolument is Rs. 37000/- per month fixed for the 1st and 2nd years, and Rs. 42000/- per month fixed for the 3rd year.

content_sections.heading: ICAR CIFE Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will work on the DBT-funded project titled "Development and Characterization of CRISPR-Cas9 mediated Myostatin Gene Knockout Muscle Cell Line for Cultivated Seafood Development" at ICAR-CIFE, Mumbai, focusing on research involving CRISPR-Cas9, cell culture, genome editing, and cultivated seafood development.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR CIFE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your application along with required educational certificates and documents. Submit your application by email to [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches the designated email address on or before 11 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection will be based on academic performance, research experience, and performance during the interview. A walk-in-interview will be held on 16 November 2026 at 11:00 AM at ICAR-CIFE, Yari Road campus. TA/DA will not be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ICAR CIFE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for Research Associate (RA) and Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by email is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When and where will the walk-in-interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in-interview will be held on 16 November 2026 at 11:00 AM at ICAR-CIFE, Yari Road campus, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.F.Sc. in Fish Biotechnology or M.Sc. in Life Science/Biotechnology, along with 3 years of research experience in Genome Editing, Cell culture, Biotechnology, and a minimum of 2 research publications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for men and women applying for the RA and JRF posts?
faq.answer: For Research Associate, the upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. For Junior Research Fellowship, it is 35 years for men and 40 years for women.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ICAR CIFE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates may submit their application by email to [email protected] on or before 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Are these positions permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: These positions are purely temporary and contractual for a period of three years, and incumbents have no claim for regular appointment under ICAR.

faq.question: Q9. What salary or emoluments are offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The JRF position offers Rs. 37000/- per month fixed for the 1st and 2nd years, and Rs. 42000/- per month fixed for the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desirable qualifications for these posts?
faq.answer: Technical knowledge and skills in Cell Culture, Cultivated Meat/Seafood & Genome Editing are desirable for both posts.
